indexLead: The terms {brand} trades on, written for how the store actually works: we offer game keys, subscriptions and gift cards, and issue each key to your account after payment is confirmed.
indexMetaDescription: Terms, privacy, cookies, refunds, delivery, payment, key guarantee, complaints and acceptable use for {brand}.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.scope: The agreement between you and {company} when you buy from {brand}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.scope: What personal data we collect, why we use it, who processes it and your rights.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.scope: Every cookie and browser storage key the store uses, and how to change your choice.

returns.title: Refunds
returns.scope: When we refund a key, the right to cancel before a key is issued, and how refunds are paid.

shipping.title: Delivery
shipping.scope: How keys are issued to your account, how long it takes, regions and redeeming.

payment.title: Payment
payment.scope: Accepted cards, currencies, card security and when your card is charged.

warranty.title: Key guarantee
warranty.scope: Replacement or refund if a key does not activate, and a refund if it is not delivered within {hours} hours.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.scope: How to raise a complaint, how quickly we reply and where you can take it next.

acceptable-use.title: Acceptable use
acceptable-use.scope: Rules for using the website, your account and the keys you buy.
